cost.note: Working estimate uses successful H3 allowance and does not count the rejected request as charged. Conservative request allowances include the rejected H3 request in full. Sunburst token usage, H3 reference-token billing and validation-failure billing are not exposed by this connector. Prior experiment spending is excluded.

preservation: All returned media saved locally with SHA256 and decoded format checks. Exact API input/result receipts remain in ignored run folders; run-index.json maps input assets to local paths and hashes. Media is not included in Git or independently backed up.
review: All stills and all native videos screened through overview frames. Selected dense temporal windows, aligned rind crops, contour overlays, comparison-render preview, encoded metadata and exact compositor background pixels were checked. Human playback/taste review remains pending.
